user_scenario: You are Adaeze Okafor, owner of Okafor Floral Studio LLC in Chicago and the authorized contact on the shop's Beacon Ridge Energy account. You are calling early on a Friday from the shop phone, 3125550152, with a van to load, so you are upbeat but brisk, and you tend to think out loud. You explain that the studio is moving: you have signed the lease on a new storefront at 915 W Armitage Ave and you are leaving the shop at 2140 N Clybourn Ave this month. You want your electricity agreement with Beacon Ridge to move with you to the new shop - the same account, just at the new address. You do not want to cancel anything or start over with a brand-new sign-up; keeping your existing agreement is the whole point of the call. As far as you know you are still on the 12-month fixed plan you signed up for last September; wedding season has been so busy that you have not read much of the email from Beacon Ridge lately. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give the phone number and, when a second detail is asked for, the last four digits of the business's EIN, 3762; only if a further detail is asked do you give the ZIP code 60614 or the email adaeze@okaforfloral.com. If the agent asks about the new shop, you confirm the address, that it is in Chicago on ComEd like the old one, and that you get the keys mid-month; you do not know the meter read dates and ask the agent to go by the utility's schedule. If the agent asks about gas, you say the old shop has Beacon Ridge commercial gas and that you signed the new shop up for Beacon Ridge gas online earlier this week. You are fine with the agent recording the move and billing whatever the agreement says on your account. If the agent explains that your fixed term already ended and the agreement rolled over to month-to-month, that a month-to-month agreement cannot be moved, and that you can still accept the 12-month renewal offer from your letters inside the grace period, you say you would rather be back on a fixed price anyway and that you will accept that renewal offer yourself. When the agent hands you the renewal acceptance, you submit it once with exactly the plan, term, rate and dates the agent reads out, and you read back the receipt. You do not know what the letters quoted and never suggest a rate or a fee; if a number surprises you, you only ask the agent to double-check it against the records. Once the agent confirms the agreement is moving to 915 W Armitage Ave and tells you the transfer fee, you thank them, say you have to get the van loaded, and end the call.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (small_business_electricity_care, category bizpower).

[Step 0 - draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}. Assignment: grace-period renewal rate 5 factors, relocation transfer fee 4. Occupied by task 0: bizpower_ext_renewal_rate_on_acceptance, bizpower_ext_multi_site_credit_amount, bizpower_ext_closure_termination_fee, bizpower_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit and tools accept_renewal_offer_d4784688, post_multi_site_credit_fd52d0a7, post_early_termination_fee_113aa1f4, post_renewal_loyalty_credit_e53d7f06. Claimed here: bizpower_ext_relocation_transfer_fee (root, tool transfer_agreement_site_58988442, owner agent) and bizpower_ext_grace_renewal_rate (tool accept_grace_period_renewal_906a45d5, owner user). Distinct core: a relocation (bizpower_site_transfer) and a post-rollover acceptance governed by the grace-period clock, both untouched by task 0; the grace-period policy declares that such a renewal earns no loyalty credit, so it lights no obligation on task 0's loyalty policy. All six extended policies are now claimed; nothing is reserved.

[Why a good test] Adaeze Okafor asks only to move her electricity agreement to her new shop, believing she is still on her 12-month fixed plan. The records show the term ended 2026-09-23 and, because the initial renewal notice of 2026-07-30 came 55 days before the end (outside 90-60), it could not auto-renew and rolled over on 2026-09-24 to month-to-month. Base law: a month-to-month plan is not transferred. The transfer policy states: 'The relocation of an agreement that rolled over to month-to-month is not recorded until the agreement again shows a fixed term, with a term length, a contract end date and a renewal election accepted on the day its new term began.' The agent must recognise the rollover, find in the grace-period renewal rule the only write that leaves that state (acceptance inside the 15-day grace, term starting on the acceptance date), explain it, compute the rate (8.16) for her to accept herself, then compute the fee (22.00) on the renewed term. Cancel-and-enroll is excluded by her stated preference.

[Problem-tree card] Root bizpower_ext_relocation_transfer_fee; one edge -> bizpower_ext_grace_renewal_rate, kind value_input, gate months_left (also the plan fee binding), form state, negated direction (a booking 'not recorded until'), condition: term above zero, contract end date, transferable plan, election accepted and election date equal to plan change date. Exactly one write in the difficulty leaves an accepted election dated on its term's start: the grace-period acceptance (the pre-expiry acceptance starts its term the day after the old end, later than the acceptance date). Four-point test: connective 'not ... until'; XX a record state in the words of the agreement record; no tool/id/code token; hard requirement scoped to rolled-over agreements. Opening falsity: e5065313-395a-411c-be79-fa396b94092f.variant_name = Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable, term_months 0, contract_end_date '', renewal_election none, plan_change_date 2026-09-24. Resolved by accept_grace_period_renewal_906a45d5 (owner user), the customer's own write. Topological order: grace renewal (step 8) then transfer (step 10). Deletion run: skipping step 8 makes the fee 0 (month-to-month plan fee 0.00, no contract end) instead of 22.00 and drops the renewal from the terminal row. user_scenario never mentions the rollover, month-to-month, grace or renewal before the agent does; the tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Step 8 (bizpower_renew): bizpower_renewal_active (e5065313-395a-411c-be79-fa396b94092f active); bizpower_post_expiry_grace (time; anchor bizpower_agreements.plan_change_date 2026-09-24; 15 calendar days; inclusive; window closes end of 2026-10-09; frozen 2026-10-02 is day 8; 2026-10-10 would be refused). Step 10 (bizpower_site_transfer): transfer_active (e5065313-395a-411c-be79-fa396b94092f active). Inherited base conditions on the new site, checked from find_premises: same customer, commercial, ComEd like the old site, 31,500 kWh under the 300,000 limit, no live electricity agreement or C&I contract on 74983a52-c84a-4f13-b662-94e7ea576859; plan Fixed 12 allows transfers after the renewal; effective on 74983a52-c84a-4f13-b662-94e7ea576859's next scheduled read 2026-10-19.
